questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train young dentists in deontology. What is the first advice he should give them?
options: Deontology is the foundation of patient trust
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Deontology is the foundation of patient trust. Without ethics, there is no trust relationship.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create a training center in dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The main objective is to train ethical and responsible practitioners.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must evaluate the ethical practice of a young dentist. What measure is most important?
options: Respect for the Code of Ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Respect for the Code of Ethics is the most important measure for evaluating a dentist's practice.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must manage a crisis: a dentist has violated the Code of Ethics. What is the priority?
options: Protect the patient and the image of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and the image of the profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train residents in ethical risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management is an ethical responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical risk management is a fundamental ethical responsibility.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create a guide to good ethical practices. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Good ethical practices must be based on updated scientific data.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train young dentists in ethical communication. What is the key message?
options: Ethical communication is at the heart of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical communication is at the heart of the patient relationship.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create a research program in dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Research in dental ethics aims to improve ethical practices.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must manage a reference practice in ethics. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical excellence is based on continuing education and ethics.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must evaluate the impact of ethics on public health. What is the role of ethics?
options: It is essential for patient trust
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethics is essential for patient trust.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train residents in ethical innovation. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical innovation concerns new technologies, digital ethics, and new deontological challenges.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create an evaluation system for ethical skills. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Evaluation of ethical skills aims to improve ethical practices.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in the evaluation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must manage an ethical conflict. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the Code of Ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The Code of Ethics is the guide for resolving ethical conflicts.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must write an article on the future of dental deontology. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Ethical innovation in the service of the patient
The decline in the need for ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The future of deontology rests on ethical innovation in the service of the patient.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create an ethical quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Equipment and size of the practice
Ethics, transparency, and respect for the code
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethics, transparency, and respect for the code are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs passionate and ethical visionaries
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The profession needs passionate and ethical visionaries.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a scholarship for students in dental ethics. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Encouraging ethical excellence is an investment in the future.' Dr. Manal: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must pass on her knowledge in ethics. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will invest myself in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a peer network for young dentists in ethics. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual support and sharing of ethical experiences
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists in ethics.' Dr. Manal: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must write a conclusion to her work on deontology. What is the final sentence?
options: Deontology is the soul of the dental profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Deontology is the soul of the dental profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful inheritance?
options: Ethical values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical values and example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must train future mentors in ethics. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write a letter to future dentists about ethics. What message should he convey?
options: Ethics is a fundamental pillar of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethics is a fundamental pillar of the dental profession.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create an award for ethical young dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Stimulating ethical excellence is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, after a life dedicated to ethics, receives national recognition. Dr. Manal is by his side. What is Dr. Mourad's message to young dentists?
options: Ethics is the heart of the dental profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad concludes: 'Ethics is the heart of the dental profession. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Manal: 'I am proud of you.'
